lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Can your hands make a tiny nest for Pip? You can try, or simply watch with us.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: My hands make a little nest. A cozy little nest.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Let's settle close and open Pip the Pocket Dinosaur.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: A fern went rustle, rustle in the quiet garden. Ada peeked beneath it and found a tiny dinosaur curled beside a berry.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: She held her hand still, so he could sniff one finger. “Hello, little Pip,” she whispered.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Pip yawned and looked this way, then that way. “Looking for your bed?” Ada asked.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: She cupped her hands low, and Pip stepped in. Into her soft pocket he snuggled—close and warm, close and warm.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: His eyes look sleepy. Cozy, cozy. Could we rest our hands like his little pocket, or just watch?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Yes, either is lovely. You can cup your hands softly, or watch quietly. Pip is snuggled in Ada's soft pocket.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Beside the ferns, Ada spotted tiny footprints in the soft soil. “A little trail for little feet!”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: She followed them slowly, so Pip could rest. Step, step, softly—close and warm, close and warm.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The footprints led to a nest of dry leaves beneath the pear tree. Pip peeped and wiggled toward it, so Ada lowered her hands.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: He climbed into the nest and tucked his nose beneath his tail. Ada laid a leaf beside him—close and warm, close and warm.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Maybe his peep means he likes the nest, or his wiggle means he wants to climb in? Could it be either?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Either could fit. He moves toward the nest, then climbs in and curls up. Ada gently lays a leaf beside him.

pages.qa_grounding: Pip peeped and wiggled toward it

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Pip gave one sleepy peep, and Ada whispered, “Goodnight.” She tiptoed inside and snuggled into her own bed.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Pip slept in his leafy nest; Ada slept beneath her quilt. Close and warm, close and warm.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rest your nest hands together, if you like, and wish Pip a cozy sleep.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: Cozy sleep, Pip. Cozy, cozy.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Goodnight, Pip. Goodnight, Ada.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Subscribe and come back for our next story. We'll share another quiet adventure together.
